note: Land and naval battle views, the battle modifier list, tactics and the battle record. Terms come from the glossary (division = Host, convoy = Merchant Fleet, aircraft = Flier, task force = Fleet, battleship = Great Warship, submarine = Corsair, manpower = Levies, equipment = Gear); tactic names are the battle words of a pre-gunpowder age.

lit.ARMY_AMOUNT_PENALTY: §RThis commander leads too many {army:p:lc}. Every stat falls by $PENALTY|Y1%$.§!
lit.ARMY_HQ_BADGE_TOOLTIP: The §Y{army_hq}§! of §Y$NAME$§! has been drawn into the fight.
lit.BATTLE_REINFORCE_CHANCE2: Chance of joining the front rank if picked: $VALUE|2G%$
lit.BM_ACTIVE_CODE_CRACKING_BONUSES_DESC: These {division:p:lc} can read the seals of some enemy {country:p:lc} and fight with {intel_advantage:lc} against them.
lit.BM_AIR_SUPPORT_DESC: {air_wing:p} overhead help the {division:p:lc} in the battle below.
lit.BM_AMPH_PENALTY_DESC: A {naval_invasion:lc} is hard fighting from the first step ashore. Land light {division:p:lc} of {marine:p:lc} where you can, and cover the landing with the fire of {battleship:p:lc} at sea.
lit.BM_BORDER_WAR_MODIFIER_DESC: The host gains or loses strength according to how the border skirmish is going.
lit.BM_DECRYPTION_DESC: {division:p} with {intel_advantage:lc} deal more damage and take less.
lit.BM_DUGIN_MODIFIER_DESC: The longer a host holds a province, the harder it is to drive out.
lit.BM_ENCIRCLEMENT_PENALTY_DESC: Troops caught in a ring of enemies cannot call for aid or supplies, and they fight worse for it.
lit.BM_ENEMY_AIR_SUPERIORITY_COUNTER_DESC: {anti_air:p} among your {division:p:lc} blunt the penalty to defence and breach that comes with the enemy's {air_superiority:lc}, and they strike down {aircraft:p:lc} that attack the host directly.
lit.BM_ENEMY_AIR_SUPERIORITY_DESC: It is hard to hold a line while the enemy rules the sky.
lit.BM_EXILE_LEADER_DIVISION_DESC: An exiled {commander:lc} leads exiled {division:p:lc}, and they fight as one.
lit.BM_FORT_MODIFIER_DESC: Walls and forts lower the defenders' losses and add to their defence. Against a heavily fortified province, bring {engineer:p:lc} or {artillery:lc}. Attacking from several sides weakens the forts.
lit.BM_FORT_MODIFIER_DESC_WITH_RAILWAY_GUN: Walls and forts lower the defenders' losses and add to their defence. Against a heavily fortified province, bring {engineer:p:lc}, {artillery:lc} or great engines. Attacking from several sides weakens the forts.
lit.BM_HATES_COUNTRY_DESC: Your {division:p:lc} gain bonuses when they fight certain {country:p:lc}.
lit.BM_HATES_COUNTRY_ON_CORE_DESC: Your {division:p:lc} gain bonuses on their own core lands when they fight certain {country:p:lc}.
lit.BM_MULTIPLE_DESC: The host is spread too thin to fight well.
lit.BM_MULTIPLE_DIRECTIONS_DESC: Striking from several sides widens the {combat_width:lc}. A fortified province loses part of its fort bonus.
lit.BM_PARADROP_DESC: {division:p} are thrown into disorder after a sky landing.
lit.BM_RAILWAY_GUN_BOMBARD_DESC: Great engines nearby are battering the dug-in enemy and his fortified positions.
lit.BM_RIVER_PENALTY_DESC: Wading a river under enemy fire is a bloody business.
lit.BM_SHORE_BOMBARD_DESC: {battleship:p} in the sea province beside the battle are lending their fire to it.
lit.BM_STACKING_DESC: Too many {division:p:lc} cannot be led well at once.
lit.BM_SUPPLY_DESC: Troops short of {supply:lc} cannot fight well.
lit.BM_TERRAIN_DESC: Choose {division:p:lc} that suit the ground where you mean to fight.
lit.BM_WIDTH_DESC: More {division:p:lc} are committed than the {combat_width:lc} allows, so they fight poorly.
lit.CAPITAL_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YBattle Line§! carries the main striking power of the fleet, usually {battleship:p:lc} and heavy {cruiser:p:lc}. It also keeps enemy great ships from firing on friendly §YWing-Ships§!.
lit.CARRIER_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YWing-Ship Group§! gives the fleet its long reach. Shielded from the enemy by the §YScreen§! and the §YBattle Line§!, its wings can strike without interference. Any §Y{convoy:p:lc}§! caught in the battle gather here too.
lit.CARRIER_EFFICIENCY_DESC: The lower the readiness, the fewer {aircraft:p:lc} can rise and fly their missions.
lit.CARRIER_PLANE_SCREEN_DESC: Our wing-ship {aircraft:p:lc} limit how freely the enemy can move and help every screening effort.
lit.CARRIER_PLANE_SCREEN_DETAIL: Our wing-ship {aircraft:p:lc} can screen $NUM|.0H$ ships and are screening $NUM_2|.0H$ now.
lit.CARRIER_STACK_PENALTY_DESC:
§HStrike Penalty of Wing-Ships§!

$PERC|H%0$ of the wings can strike the enemy.

This share follows from the number of {aircraft:p:lc} we have in the air and the makeup of the enemy fleet.

At least $MINIMUM|H$ {aircraft:p:lc} can fly before penalties begin. The enemy fleet's makeup lets $ENEMY_FLEET|H$ be used well. The higher of the two numbers counts.
lit.COMBAT_ARMOR_DESC: $PIERCING|H$ of $TOTAL|H$ enemy {division:p:lc} can pierce the armour of this {division:lc}.
lit.COMBAT_ATTACKER_WINNING: §YThe attackers are gaining the upper hand.§!
lit.COMBAT_COMBAT_WIDTH_DESC:
§H{combat_width}§!
 Sets how many {division:p:lc} on each side can join the fight. The room a host takes depends on how it is built. Attacking from several sides adds to the total.
lit.COMBAT_EXILES_DESC: §HExiled Veterans§! fight with bonuses against $AMOUNT|H$ of $TOTAL|H$ enemy {division:p:lc}.
lit.COMBAT_EXILES_DESC_DELAYED: Facing the occupiers of their homeland. Attack: $ATK_VS_OCCUPIER|%+$ Defence: $DEF_VS_OCCUPIER|%+$
lit.COMBAT_EXILES_ON_CORES_DESC: §HExiled Veterans§! fighting on their own core land. Attack: $ATK_ON_CORE|%+$ Defence: $DEF_ON_CORE|%+$.
lit.COMBAT_LAST_LESS_THAN_DAY: We reckon the battle will end within a day.
lit.COMBAT_LAST_MORE_THAN_DAY: We reckon the battle has $DAYS|Y$ days more to run.
lit.COMBAT_LOG_BATTLE_ATTACKER_DESC: Our {division:p:lc} stood on the §Hattacking§! side of this battle.
lit.COMBAT_LOG_BATTLE_DEFENDER_DESC: Our {division:p:lc} stood on the §Hdefending§! side of this battle.
lit.COMBAT_LOG_BATTLE_LOCATION_STATE: This battle was fought in a province of the state $NAME|H$.
lit.COMBAT_LOG_BATTLE_OVERRUN_LOSS: Our {division:p:lc} were §HRun Down§! by the enemy.
lit.COMBAT_LOG_BATTLE_OVERRUN_WIN: The enemy {division:p:lc} were §HRun Down§! by us.
lit.COMBAT_LOG_MP_LOST_DESC:
§H{manpower} lost§!
To enemy ground forces: $GND|R$
To enemy {aircraft:p:lc}: $AIR|R$
lit.COMBAT_LOG_MP_LOST_WITH_NAVY_DESC:
§H{manpower} lost§!
To enemy ground forces: $GND|R$
To enemy {aircraft:p:lc}: $AIR|R$
To enemy ships: $NAVY|R$
lit.COMBAT_LOG_OVERRUN_DESC: To be §HRun Down§! is to be wiped out entirely. It befalls a {division:lc} that retreats into a province which then falls to the enemy.
lit.COMBAT_PIERCING_DESC: This {division:lc} can pierce the armour of $PIERCING|H$ of $TOTAL|H$ armoured enemy {division:p:lc}.
lit.COMBAT_PROGRESS_DESC: Shows how the strength of attacker and defender stands in this battle.
lit.COMBAT_RESERVES:
The reserve holds {division:p:lc} that have not yet joined the fight.

When there is room on the {combat_width:lc}, one {division:lc} from the reserve tries to join each hour of battle.

A {division:lc} with a higher reinforcement rate is more likely to be chosen.
lit.COMMAND_ARMY_GROUP_DESC: A {army_group} brings {army:p:lc} together under high orders and plans.
lit.COMMAND_GROUP_CANT_REASSIGN: §RNone of the chosen {division:p:lc} can leave their present {army:p:lc}.§!
lit.COMMAND_GROUP_DESC: A {battle_plan:lc} needs an {army:lc} to carry it out. With one, large bodies of troops can be moved in several steps.
lit.COMREIC_TOO_MUCH_WIDTH: Takes up too much frontage and would bring a heavy penalty.
lit.CREATE_ARMY_GROUP_WITH_UNITS_SELECTED_TO: §GClick to raise a new {army_group:lc} and give it the chosen {army:p:lc}§!
lit.CREATE_GROUP_WITH_UNITS_SELECTED_TOOLTIP: §GClick to raise a new {army:lc} and give it the chosen {division:p:lc}§!
lit.DIFFERENT_COMMANDER_DESC: A {division:lc} here has a different commander from the one leading the battle. That commander gives it its bonuses, but the tactic chosen for the battle is up to the commander in charge.
lit.DISENGAGE_FROM_COMBAT:
§HBreak Off§!

Order your {task_force:p:lc} to leave the fight.
lit.DISENGAGE_FROM_COMBAT_DONE: Your {task_force:p:lc} are already trying to break off.
lit.EQUIPMENT_RECOVERY_ENTRY: This piece of {equipment:lc} has a Reliability of $RELIABILITY|%.0Y$, so each piece lost has a $RECOVERY|%G$ chance of being saved when the battle ends.
lit.EQUIPMENT_RECOVERY_ENTRY_GENERAL: A {division:lc} saves part of its {equipment:lc} after a battle. The higher a piece's Reliability, the better its chance of being saved. Choose the §YFull list§! view to see single items.
lit.HARDNESS_COMBAT_DESC:
{hardness}: $HARDNESS|Y0%$
Takes $SOFTNESS|Y0%$ of all {soft_attack:lc}.
Takes $HARDNESS|Y0%$ of all {hard_attack:lc}.
lit.LACK_OF_FUEL_DESC: A {division:lc} short of {fuel:lc} moves slower, and the stats of its armoured companies fall.
lit.LAND_COMBAT_CAS_INFO:
Brought down in all: $LOST|R$
£organization_texticon Cohesion lost: $ORG|R0$
£strenght_texticon Strength lost: $STR|R0$
lit.LAND_COMBAT_CAS_INFO_TOOLTIP:
About $NUM|Y$ {aircraft:p:lc} of the $SIDE$ side have lately helped in this battle.
They have dealt $ORG|G0$ damage to §YCohesion§!, and the enemy's §YCohesion§! now stands at $ORG_MAX|G0$.
They have dealt $STR|G0$ damage to §YStrength§!, and the enemy's §YStrength§! now stands at $STR_MAX|G0$.
The §Y{anti_air:p}§! of the enemy {division:p:lc} brought down $KILL|R$ {aircraft:p:lc} and, at $AA_EFFECTIVENESS|H%1$ effectiveness, spared $ORG_PREVENT|R0$ §YCohesion§! and $STR_PREVENT|R0$ §YStrength§! from harm.
lit.LAND_COMBAT_CAS_INFO_TOOLTIP_DETAIL: At most $MAX_PLANES|Y$ {aircraft:p:lc} can help. The wider the {combat_width:lc} in use, the more can fit.
lit.LAND_COMBAT_TOOLTIP_NO_INTEL: No scout has brought you word of this battle.
lit.LEADER_HAS_INITIATIVE:
§HInitiative§!
This side holds the initiative, either because its {division:p:lc} scout better or because its commander is more skilled.
It gets an extra chance to choose a tactic that counters the other side's.
lit.MISSION_AIR_SUPERIORITY_WIN: Enemy {aircraft:p:lc} brought down (with help from wings on guard): $VAL|0+$
lit.MISSION_INTERCEPTION_WIN: Enemy {aircraft:p:lc} brought down (with help from wings holding the sky): $VAL|0+$
lit.NAVAL_COMBAT_ATTACKER_ACTUAL_PARTICIPANT: The attacking side ( $COUNTRY|Y$ ) has $COUNT|Y$ ships in the fight now.
lit.NAVAL_COMBAT_CLICK_DESC:
§GClick to watch the battle unfold.§!
§GRight-click to pan to the fight.§!
lit.NAVAL_COMBAT_DEFENDER_ACTUAL_PARTICIPANT: The defending side ( $COUNTRY|Y$ ) has $COUNT|Y$ ships in the fight now.
lit.NAVAL_INVASION_COMBAT_PROGRESS_DESC: This {division:lc} is making a {naval_invasion:lc}. Its attack is lowered, and its defence is raised by the armour of the transport.
lit.NAVAL_PIERCING_THRESHOLD_TO_DAMAGE: §Y>§!$THRESHOLD|%H0$ pierced = $DAMAGE|%H0$ chance of a crippling hit
lit.NAVAL_PIERCING_THRESHOLD_TO_DAMAGE_LOWES: §R<§!$THRESHOLD|%R0$ pierced = $DAMAGE|%R0$ chance of a crippling hit
lit.NAVAL_READY_TO_FIRE_DESC: Because of range, some classes of ship cannot strike directly when the battle is joined.
lit.NAVY_PIERCING_TOOLTIP_INFO:
§YPiercing§!
The heavy bolt-throwers on ships have a better chance of a crippling hit on an enemy ship, depending on their piercing value against the target's armour:
lit.NON_PIERCING_THRESHOLD_ENTRY: $NUM|H$ enemy {division:p:lc} cannot pierce the armour of this {division:lc} and deal only $PIERCE_VALUE|%H$ of their damage.
lit.OPEN_ARMY_LEADER_PREFERRED_TACTIC_SELECT: You may choose a §HPreferred Tactic§! for this commander.
lit.PIERCING_COMBAT_DESC: Damage depends on the share of enemy armour pierced:
lit.PIERCING_ENEMIES_THRESHOLD_ENTRY: This {division:lc} gets $PIERCE_VALUE|%H$ of its damage through the armour of $NUM|H$ enemy {division:p:lc}.
lit.PIERCING_THRESHOLD_ENTRY: $NUM|H$ enemy {division:p:lc} get $PIERCE_VALUE|%H$ of their damage through the armour of this {division:lc}.
lit.POSITIONING_INFO:
§HPlacement§! shows how well your fleet is set against the enemy. It depends on the size of the fleets, the weather and the skill of the commanders. Ships that join a battle already under way suffer a short penalty to Placement.

Below 100%, the fleet suffers penalties.
lit.SCREENING_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YScreen§! holds the screening ships, usually light {cruiser:p:lc} and {destroyer:p:lc}, who keep enemy screens away from the main §YBattle Line§!. Without enough screening, enemy screens can strike the battle line with fire-bolts.
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_BONUSES: Your screening gives these bonuses to your §YBattle Line§!:
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_BONUSES_CAPITAL: Your screening gives these bonuses to your §YWing-Ship Group§!:
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_CAPITAL_BOX_COMBINED: Combined screening reaching past the §YBattle Line§!: $NUM|%.0H$
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_FOR_CAPITAL_BOX: Your $NUM_CARR|.0H$ §YWing-Ships§! and $NUM_CONV|.0H$ §Y{convoy:p}§! need $NUM_NEED|.0H$ §Y{battleship:p}§! to be fully screened, and you have $NUM_CAPI|.0H$ §Y{battleship:p}§!.
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_FOR_SCREEN_BOX: Your $NUM_CAPI|.0H$ §Y{battleship:p}§!, $NUM_CARR|.0H$ §YWing-Ships§! and $NUM_CONV|.0H$ §Y{convoy:p}§! need $NUM_NEED|.0H$ §YScreening Ships§! to be fully screened, and you have $NUM_SCRE|.0H$ §YScreening Ships§!.
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_LOW_INFO: Gaps in the §YScreen§! leave the screening weak, so enemy {submarine:p:lc} can reach the next line.
lit.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_NO_SCREENS: With no §YScreening Ships§!, enemy {submarine:p:lc} and other light ships can strike your {battleship:p:lc} with fire-bolts, and your Placement suffers heavily.
lit.SELECT_ARMY_GROUP_WITH_UNITS_SELECTED_TO: §GRight-click§! to give the chosen §Y{army:p}§! to this {army_group:lc}
lit.SELECT_GROUP_TOOLTIP_WITH_HQ:
§GClick§! to pick all {division:p:lc}
§GCtrl+Click§! to pick all but the {army_hq:p:lc}
lit.SELECT_GROUP_WITH_RAILWAY_GUNS_SELECTED_: §GRight-click§! to place the chosen §YGreat Engines§! in this {army:lc}
lit.SELECT_GROUP_WITH_RWGS_SELECTED_TOOLTIP: §GRight-click§! to place the chosen §YGreat Engines§! in this {army:lc}
lit.SELECT_GROUP_WITH_UNITS_SELECTED_TOOLTIP: §GRight-click§! to give the chosen §Y{division:p}§! to this {army:lc}
lit.SUBMARINE_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YCorsair Pack§! lurks unseen and tries to finish off fleeing ships with fire-bolts. If the enemy has no ships fit to hunt {submarine:p:lc}, they slip away unnoticed.
lit.TACTICS_COMBAT_DESC: Changes to damage and pace from tactics:
lit.TACTICS_CURRENT_PHASE_DESC: The phase the battle is in. Only tactics of this phase can be chosen by the commanders leading each side.
lit.TACTICS_LIST_DESC:
§HList of Tactics§!

Shows the tactics, open and closed, that may be used in the battle.
lit.TACTICS_LOCKED_BY_TECH: Opened by one of these doctrines:$TECH$
lit.TACTICS_SCOPE_WEIGHT: Weight of the tactic with traits applied: $WEIGHT|H$
lit.TACTIC_CONDITIONS_NOT_MET: The conditions to choose this tactic are not met.
lit.TACTIC_CURRENTLY_COUNTERED: §RThe enemy has met this tactic with its counter.§!
lit.TACTIC_TOTAL_WEIGHT: Combined weight of all tactics that apply: $WEIGHT|H$
lit.TACTIC_WEIGHT_MODIFIER_ARMY_GENERAL_PREF: Preferred tactic of the army commander: $MODIFIER|H$
lit.UNIT_AMOUNT_PENALTY: §RThis commander leads too many bodies of troops. Every stat falls by $PENALTY|Y1%$.§!
lit.WING_CAN_NOT_ATTACH_ALREADY: §RNo wing is left to bind: every one already rides with the {army:lc}.§!
lit.WING_CAN_NOT_ATTACH_ARMY_GROUP: §ROnly an {army:lc} can have wings bound to it, not a {army_group:lc}.§!
lit.WING_CAN_NOT_ATTACH_WRONG_TYPE: §RShip-striking wings and deep-raiding wings cannot be bound to {army:p:lc}.§!
